revalidation: Verified completed actual-search-tree closure bindings and specific owner /proc/868384 missing; inspected current code and existing result summaries; no restart or repeated completed experiment.
objective_policy: No single scalar mixes legal failure and CPD. Retain all statuses; assess legal success, circuit-aggregated matched CPD and regression tails, then complete-process cost. Query coverage, planning score and audit PASS are intermediate evidence, not QoR.
best_candidate_assessment: No uniformly validated best new method. Tf improves original count1 seen cohort but loses to oldR1 in the stronger four-circuit count2 cohort. U closure-view has the only cited five-circuit rotated formal timing benefit vs oldR1, still slower than A0. Latest actual-tree stage is diagnostic, not promoted.
causal_assessment: Complete distances can worsen CPD; inaccurate distances alone cannot explain all losses.
Actual remaining-target updates sometimes improve count1 quality; updates to retained guides often cannot act immediately.
Unguided critical-path connections can regress after changes elsewhere; indirect congestion/path migration plausible, not causally isolated.
Search scope and additional convergence account for material apparent benefits and require matched controls.
Actual-tree graph walk and fixed-tree extension differ; 8 of76 intersecting witnesses become more expensive after actual-prefix attachment.
Current residual and preferred interval queries do not directly select keep/release guides; their neutrality is not evidence against decision use.

priority_decisions.question: Does tree-aware modeling alter usable decisions, not just bounds?
priority_decisions.action: Implement already registered P/I/L/IL offline factorial on existing3809 contexts at256 expansions; preserve all statuses; add candidate-satisfaction classification from real tree ancestry.
priority_decisions.next: Measure action-sensitive contexts and current criticality, then implement search-local guide decision intervention in timing_driven_route_connection_from_heap. Do not wait indefinitely for all intervals to become exact.
priority_decisions.discriminant: If candidate rankings/eligible decisions barely change, deprioritize additional query-precision work and move to critical-path repair/decision objective.

priority_decisions.question: Is the dominant critical-path loss actually repairable in the fixed placed graph?
priority_decisions.action: Use saved final critical and near-critical paths, retained-tree anchors and actual feasible alternative suffixes. First distinguish uncongested relaxed distance from fixed-tree attachable path and capacity-feasible repair.
priority_decisions.next: For paths with real potential, isolated transactional targeted repair and reroute replay followed by full STA, with same-scope/count A0/R1/Tf controls; final-path selections are diagnostic oracle interventions, not deployable online policy.
priority_decisions.discriminant: If local repair helps but current guide fails, change consumer/selection; if relaxed potential exists but feasible repair does not, investigate congestion/retained-tree coupling; if even relaxed potential is small, change target module.

priority_decisions.question: Does fixed median hierarchy/opening surrogate suppress useful sharing or splitting?
priority_decisions.action: Small-net arbitrary partition/reference search using the same physical candidate table; separate hierarchy relaxation from timing/slack-oriented objective and retained-resource accounting.
priority_decisions.next: Translate promising assignments to transactional native tests; no global Steiner or STA optimality claim.

priority_decisions.question: Can success improve independently of extra search scope?
priority_decisions.action: Failure-driven local scope or critical corridor changes, each paired with native A0 under identical scope and stopping policy. Treat fixed-SOURCE capacity obstruction separately; endpoint/placement change defines a new matched cohort.

priority_decisions.question: Which costs remain worth optimizing?
priority_decisions.action: Retain exact SCC/view/cached-distance optimizations; prefer decision-sensitive work allocation over more blanket precision. Re-time stable integrated candidates in same environment.
priority_decisions.next: Formal U planning/process ratios are about2.15–5.49 percent; these descriptive ratios are not rigorous speedup bounds or current-query formal timings.

Storage-loss means no lower certificate. A strict U_alternative < L_preferred can certify only modeled dominance; avoid claiming U_preferred < L_unrestricted because unrestricted includes preferred.
integration_contract.actions: Search-local guide retention/release/reassignment or additional query work; unknown intervals remain unknown. First decision pilot separates tree modeling from policy activation; evaluate physical Tdel/congestion/STA unchanged.
